why: Review 5 finding 4: a class folder's `private/` function is visible only to the folder's own functions (doc 'Private Functions'; MATLAB R2026a: from a function outside `@Qpz`, `numel(k)` on a `Qpz` runs MATLAB's `numel`, a double, not `@Qpz/private/numel.m`). In `use1.m`, outside the folder, `k = numel(k)` leaves a double: `tidy(k)` is the plain `tidy`. In `@Gizmo/inside.m`, and in `@Gizmo/private/helper.m` (a private function reaches its own folder's: doc 'Private Functions'), the private `numel` runs and gives the object back (project rule): `Gizmo::tidy`.
